name: CIS Microsoft Azure Storage Services Benchmark
note: Each test implements the audit procedure of the recommendation it is mapped to; partial marks where the test differs from the audit. Recommendations about SAS tokens as they are generated cannot be read from configuration and have no test.

3.1.1.title: Ensure soft delete on Backup vaults is Enabled

3.1.2.title: Ensure immutability for Backup vaults is Enabled

3.1.3.title: Ensure backup data in Backup vaults is encrypted using customer-managed keys (CMK)

3.1.4.title: Ensure 'Use infrastructure encryption for this vault' is enabled on Backup vaults

3.1.5.title: Ensure 'Cross Region Restore' is set to 'Enabled' on Backup vaults

3.1.6.title: Ensure 'Cross Subscription Restore' is set to 'Disabled' or 'Permanently Disabled' on Backup vaults

3.2.1.title: Ensure soft delete on Recovery Services vaults is Enabled

3.2.2.title: Ensure immutability for Recovery Services vaults is Enabled

3.2.3.title: Ensure backup data in Recovery Services vaults is encrypted using customer-managed keys (CMK)

3.2.4.title: Ensure 'Use infrastructure encryption for this vault' is enabled on Recovery Services vaults

3.2.5.title: Ensure public network access on Recovery Services vaults is Disabled

3.2.6.title: Ensure 'Cross Region Restore' is set to 'Enabled' on Recovery Services vaults

3.2.7.title: Ensure 'Cross Subscription Restore' is set to 'Disabled' or 'Permanently Disabled' on Recovery Services vaults

3.2.8.title: Ensure private endpoints are configured for Recovery Services Vaults

4.1.title: Ensure 'Key encryption key' is set to a customer-managed key for Azure Managed Lustre file systems

7.1.1.title: Ensure root squash for NFS file shares is configured (Microsoft.FileShares)

7.1.2.title: Ensure encryption in transit is required for File Shares (Microsoft.FileShares)

7.1.3.title: Ensure 'Public Endpoint Access' for File Shares is restricted to selected virtual networks (Microsoft.FileShares)

7.1.4.title: Ensure 'Public Endpoint Access' is set to 'Disabled' for File Shares (Microsoft.FileShares)

7.1.5.title: Ensure private endpoints are configured for File Shares (Microsoft.FileShares)

7.2.1.title: Ensure soft delete for Azure File Shares is Enabled (Classic File Shares)

7.2.2.title: Ensure 'SMB channel encryption' is set to 'AES-256-GCM' or higher for SMB file shares (Classic File Shares)

7.2.3.title: Ensure 'SMB protocol version' is set to 'SMB 3.1.1' or higher for SMB file shares (Classic File Shares)

7.2.4.title: Ensure root squash for NFS file shares is configured (Classic File Shares)

9.1.title: Ensure 'Encryption key source' is set to 'Customer Managed Key' for Azure NetApp Files accounts

10.1.title: Ensure 'Allowed Protocols' for shared access signature (SAS) tokens is set to 'HTTPS Only'

10.2.title: Ensure that shared access signature (SAS) tokens expire within an hour

10.3.title: Ensure that soft delete for blobs on Azure Blob Storage storage accounts is Enabled

10.4.title: Ensure stored access policies (SAP) are used when generating shared access signature (SAS) tokens

10.5.title: Ensure 'Versioning' is set to 'Enabled' on Azure Blob Storage storage accounts

10.6.title: Ensure locked immutability policies are used for containers storing business-critical blob data

11.1.title: Ensure double encryption is used for Azure Data Box in high-security environments

14.1.title: Ensure 'Public network access' is set to 'Disabled' on Azure Elastic SAN

14.2.title: Ensure customer-managed keys (CMK) are used to encrypt data at rest on Azure Elastic SAN volume groups

15.1.title: Ensure 'Allowed Protocols' for shared access signature (SAS) tokens is set to 'HTTPS Only'

15.2.title: Ensure that shared access signature (SAS) tokens expire within an hour

15.3.title: Ensure stored access policies (SAP) are used when generating shared access signature (SAS) tokens

16.1.1.title: Ensure that 'Enable key rotation reminders' is enabled for each Storage Account

16.1.2.title: Ensure 'Allowed Protocols' for shared access signature (SAS) tokens is set to 'HTTPS Only'

16.1.3.title: Ensure that Storage Account Access Keys are Periodically Regenerated

16.1.4.title: Ensure that a shared access signature (SAS) expiration policy is configured

16.1.5.title: Ensure the shared access signature (SAS) expiration policy action is set to 'Block'

16.1.6.title: Ensure that shared access signature (SAS) tokens expire within an hour

16.1.7.title: Ensure 'Allow storage account key access' for Azure Storage Accounts is 'Disabled'

16.1.8.title: Ensure Storage for Critical Data are Encrypted with Customer Managed Keys (CMK)

16.2.1.title: Ensure Private Endpoints are used to access Storage Accounts

16.2.2.title: Ensure that 'Public Network Access' is 'Disabled' for storage accounts

16.2.3.title: Ensure Default Network Access Rule for Storage Accounts is Set to Deny

16.4.title: Ensure that 'Secure transfer required' is set to 'Enabled'

16.5.title: Ensure that 'Enable Infrastructure Encryption' for Each Storage Account in Azure Storage is Set to 'Enabled'

16.6.title: Ensure 'Allow Azure services on the trusted services list to access this storage account' is Enabled for Storage Account Access

16.7.title: Ensure Soft Delete is Enabled for Azure Containers and Blob Storage

16.8.title: Ensure storage logging is Enabled for Queue Service for 'Read', 'Write', and 'Delete' requests

16.9.title: Ensure storage logging is Enabled for Blob Service for 'Read', 'Write', and 'Delete' requests

16.10.title: Ensure storage logging is Enabled for Table Service for 'Read', 'Write', and 'Delete' Requests

16.11.title: Ensure the 'Minimum TLS version' for storage accounts is set to 'Version 1.2'

16.12.title: Ensure 'Cross Tenant Replication' is not enabled

16.13.title: Ensure that 'Allow Blob Anonymous Access' is set to 'Disabled'

16.14.title: Ensure Azure Resource Manager Delete locks are applied to Azure Storage Accounts

16.15.title: Ensure Azure Resource Manager ReadOnly locks are considered for Azure Storage Accounts

16.16.title: Ensure Redundancy is set to a geo-redundant option on critical Azure Storage Accounts

17.1.title: Ensure that shared access signature (SAS) tokens expire within an hour

17.2.title: Ensure stored access policies (SAP) are used when generating shared access signature (SAS) tokens

17.3.title: Ensure Storage Explorer is using the latest version
